syn.title: Syn
syn.input_hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for new line
syn.setup_description: Syn uses Ollama to run AI models locally on your machine. No internet required, fully private.
syn.setup_step2_desc: Ollama runs in the background — Syn will detect it automatically
syn.no_models_description: Pull a model to get started. Recommended models:
syn.greeting: Hello! I'm Syn, your personal AI assistant.
syn.greeting_sub: I live inside your Synabit vault and can help you with:
syn.provider_ollama_desc: Models run on this computer. Nothing you write leaves it.
syn.provider_openai_desc: Works with OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, vLLM, LM Studio and llama.cpp. Your vault stays local; the messages you send go to the endpoint you choose.
syn.openai_base_url_desc: Include the version path, for example https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:8080/v1.
syn.api_key_stored: A key is saved — type to replace it
syn.api_key_desc: Stored in this computer's keychain, never in your vault, so it does not sync or reach git. Leave it empty for a local server that needs no key.
syn.personality_auto_example: Hey! You have 3 tasks due today. Want me to list them out?
syn.personality_casual_example: Ê, hôm nay mày có 3 task sắp deadline kìa. Để tao list ra nhé!
syn.personality_professional_example: Chào bạn, hôm nay bạn có 3 nhiệm vụ cần hoàn thành. Tôi sẽ liệt kê chi tiết.
syn.tmpl_mentor_prompt: You are a wise and experienced mentor. Give thoughtful, deep advice. Ask probing questions to help the user think critically. Use analogies and real-world examples.
syn.tmpl_writer_prompt: You are a skilled writer and editor. Focus on clear, concise communication. Help improve writing quality, suggest better phrasing, and maintain a consistent tone.
syn.tmpl_planner_prompt: You are a productivity expert. Help break down goals into actionable steps. Suggest priorities, timelines, and remind about deadlines. Be structured and systematic.
syn.tmpl_minimal_prompt: Be extremely concise. Use bullet points. No filler words. Get straight to the point. Maximum 3 sentences per response unless asked for more detail.
syn.custom_system_prompt_placeholder_v2:
Example:
- Always respond in Vietnamese
- Call me 'sếp'
- Use bullet points for lists
- Add emoji to responses
- Focus on productivity advice
syn.custom_prompt_hint: These instructions are prepended to Syn's system prompt.
syn.high_context_warning: Large context window requires significantly more RAM. May cause slowdowns on machines with limited memory.
syn.connection_lost: Ollama disconnected. Check that Ollama is running and try again.
syn.send_error_desc: Ollama may be unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
syn.pull_error_desc: Model not found or network error. Check the model name and try again.
